personality: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: An intelligent, dark-first premium utility that feels fast, deeply technical, and exceptionally organized.

spacing.rule: Generous utility spacing. Use md/lg for internal card padding, xl for section breaks. Ensure bottom padding accounts for safe area and floating selection bars.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar, floating multi-select footer, and sticky headers.
Add a subtle glow effect behind hero cards or primary CTAs using a brandTertiary radial gradient underneath.
Use blur on bottom sheets (Filter sheet, Push Config).
dont's: Do not use glass on regular list items or standard category cards.
Do not blur dense data areas like the upload queue.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the Find, Organize, Select, Push philosophy with a cinematic, dark-luxe feel.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with heavy vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #0a0a0c at 70%). Text and pagination dots in the bottom 30%. Primary CTA sticky at bottom.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure JWT login and registration with a premium, focused form.
screens.layout: Minimalist single-column form. Logo at top, inputs using surfaceTertiary background. Primary purple CTA.

screens.name: Permissions & ScanProgress
screens.purpose: Explain why storage access is needed, followed by a deeply technical, dark-first scanning indicator.

states.loading: Oversized numeric progress (e.g., 42%) with a scanning path pulsing below.

screens.layout: Centered layout for permissions with large Phosphor icon. On scan, transitions to a command-center style progress view with live file path text.

screens.name: LibraryHome
screens.purpose: The main hub to browse audio categories and recently discovered files.

states.loading: Skeleton grids for categories and lists.
states.empty: Illustration + 'No audio files found. Pull to rescan.'

screens.layout: Search bar at top (navigates to Search tab). 2-column grid for 'Smart Categories' (All, Voice Memos, Music, etc.) using surfaceSecondary cards. 'Recently Added' vertical list below. If multi-select is active, a floating glass selection bar appears above the tab bar.

screens.name: Search
screens.purpose: Universal search with live results and quick-access filter chips.
screens.layout: Sticky header with search input. Horizontal scrollable filter chips below (Duration, Format). Live vertical list of audio files.

screens.name: AudioDetail
screens.purpose: View extensive metadata for a single file and preview playback.
screens.layout: Large title, surfaceSecondary card for metadata rows (Size, Duration, Format, Path). Sticky preview player (Play/Pause/Seek) at the bottom. Push button secondary action.

screens.name: PushConfig
screens.purpose: Configure upload settings (quality, note) before pushing to tunAide Transcribe.
screens.layout: Presented as a full-screen sheet or modal. Summary of selected files at top. Options for Upload Quality (segmented control), Priority, Note (text input). 'Push Now' / 'Add to Queue' primary CTAs at bottom.

screens.name: Activity
screens.purpose: Monitor live uploads and transcription statuses.

states.error: Failed rows highlighted in error color

screens.layout: Sticky top tabs (Uploads | Transcriptions). Vertical list of files with live progress bars (using brandPrimary for active, success for complete). Retry/Cancel icons on trailing edge.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage user account, app preferences, and storage management.
screens.layout: Standard grouped list layout (surfaceSecondary sections) with simple toggle switches and navigation chevrons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color override: Use '#0a0a0c' for background and '#9D4EDD' (purple) for primary CTAs, active states, and highlights.
Implement the 'Dark-First Utility' layout style: clean lists, clear hierarchy, high-contrast text, minimal borders.

Ensure the Multi-Select floating bar is implemented using a sticky bottom container with `expo-blur` (glass effect) hovering just above the tab bar, showing 'X files selected' and a primary 'Push' button.
On the Activity screen, use precise, tactical progress bars for the upload queue, ensuring technical clarity.
Avoid making the app look like a Spotify clone. Category cards should look like file folders or data metrics, not album art.
Implement the gradient scrim overlay exactly as detailed in the <Imagery_and_Texture> rules for any text positioned over the onboarding hero image.
Apply 'brandTertiary' subtle backgrounds to feature icons or category avatars to give that premium glowing effect without overusing gradients.
Do NOT use heavy shadows. Use spacing and surface colors (surfaceSecondary vs surface) to establish depth.
